name: ClawPhylax
description: Verify skills are safe before installing and see where installed skills send data: scans a skill folder for hosts, uploads and credential reads; attributes every outbound connection at runtime to the skill or tool that caused it; flags exfiltration patterns and unexpected hosts. Local ledger, no cloud, observe-only by default.

cliCommands.name: clawphylax
cliCommands.description: Report outbound network activity per skill and tool call

mode.description: observe: record and flag only (default). enforce: block exec commands and in-process requests to denylisted hosts.

notify.description: footer: append a one-line summary to the agent reply when a run contacted new or suspicious hosts (default). off: ledger only.

denylist.description: Extra hostnames or suffixes treated as suspicious (merged with the built-in list).

allowlist.description: Hostnames or suffixes never flagged and never blocked.
